text:
anya (Marketing): quick flag — I pulled a report and ~40 inbound leads from the last 24h are unassigned and missing enrichment (company/org data). noticed the round-robin assignment didn't run for that pool :thinking_face:

mike (RevOps): ugh. thanks for catching. can you paste an example lead id? also which workflow/owner pool is this tied to?

anya (Marketing): example: lead 00712 (email: jd+test@example.com). workflow is `HS:Inbound - PLG trial -> assign-sales-rotations-v3`

linda (Growth): is this the pool that should skip micro leads (MQL < 10) — we had a fix last month to avoid assigning low-fit ones. might be colliding with enrichment step.

mike (RevOps): right — two things could cause this: the enrichment webhook failing (so owner remains null) OR the round-robin job not seeing the lead because contact property `enrichment_status` is `failed`. i'm going to check the hubspot-sync logs. pinging the bot: @hubspot-sync-bot status for workflow `assign-sales-rotations-v3` starting 24h ago

hubspot-sync-bot: fetching logs for workflow assign-sales-rotations-v3 (24h window)... found 3 errors, 1 timeout, 36 processed, 41 total. last run at 1790001190. sample error: "enrichment API 502"

sean (AE): if enrichment fails, does it ever fall back to a manual queue? some leads are time-sensitive and we need an SLA to get them to SDRs.

mike (RevOps): good point. current behavior: if `enrichment_status` != `complete` -> do not auto-assign. fallback/new flow proposal: automatic fallback to "unassigned-review" queue after 10m with a task created and tag `needs-enrichment` so SDRs can triage. SLA: SDRs should claim within 2 business hours.

linda (Growth): +1 to the fallback queue. we should also surface leads where enrichment repeatedly fails (3 attempts) to product for upstream fix.

anya (Marketing): can we implement a short-term fix to force assignment for high-intent leads even if enrichment fails? e.g., `lead_score >= 80` override and assign via round-robin with `fallback=true` property.

mike (RevOps): yes — config change looks like this (HubSpot workflow condition):
```
IF (enrichment_status != 'complete') AND (lead_score >= 80) THEN assign owner via rotation 'Inbound-HighIntent' set property 'assignment_override' = 'enrichment-fallback'
```
I'll slide this into the workflow and run a dry-run for the last 48h to see number of affected leads.

sean (AE): please add a note to the SDR slack channel so they know to expect `fallback=true` leads — they should prioritize those.

linda (Growth): also email ops@redwood with a short runbook: how to handle `needs-enrichment` tasks (check enrichment endpoint, quick manual data fill, mark enrichment_status).

mike (RevOps): action items:
- mike: enable `lead_score >= 80` override (dry-run by 1790001500)
- mike: create fallback queue `unassigned-review` and task template by EOD
- anya: flag sample leads and add to audit sheet (shared)
- sean: notify SDRs in #sdr-ops with snippet and example tasks

anya (Marketing): thanks — i'll add the audit sheet and drop sample rows. tagging @sean and @linda when done. :thumbsup:

hubspot-sync-bot: update scheduled: apply dry-run changes at 1790001450, will report counts.

mike (RevOps): follow-up: dry-run shows 9 high-intent leads that would've been auto-assigned, 32 left for fallback queue. sounds reasonable. i'll flip the override to live after 30m of review.

sean (AE): confirming SDRs got the heads-up. one asked how to mark a lead as "manually enriched" — we should add a quick KB link.

linda (Growth): i'll draft a one-pager and add to marketing playbooks.

anya (Marketing): great teamwork. let's circle back tomorrow AM to verify no new noise.

mike (RevOps): will monitor and post a summary at 1790002000.
